name: vep_cache
description: The Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor's indexed cache: the transcript models, regulatory features and known variants VEP annotates against, for one species and assembly at one Ensembl release.

GRCh38.naming: Ensembl: 1, 2, X, MT. Fits an Ensembl GRCh38 genome, at the release its annotation is at; not a UCSC- or NCBI-named one.

GRCh37.naming: Ensembl: 1, 2, X, MT. Fits an Ensembl GRCh37 genome, at the release its annotation is at; not a UCSC- or NCBI-named one.
